evidence_type: engineering study arithmetic; not a circuit qualification or physical measurement
authorization: User agreed to study electronic protection; no topology promoted to main CAD

accounting_comparison.limitations: Accounting on incumbent copper only; removing the fuse changes routing. Header, holder, further heating, tolerances and new routing not qualified. TPS25982 resistance tested at 2A, not 5A.

comparator.screening_includes: 19.85..20.15 uA threshold source; initial 0.1% RLIMIT / 0.5% shunt; conservative +/-650 uV offset envelope
comparator.missing: Temperature/ageing, actual VCM/supply rejection, input wiring/filter error and NAF validation; no maximum response guarantee inferred from a typical delay
comparator.input_bias_spec_condition: 25 C table condition; enabled; not a full-temperature or unpowered bound
comparator.supply_owner: Independent Pico 3V3, not the measured DUT rail
comparator.bias_boundary: IN- is an explicit additional measured-side input current; calibration must retain/characterize it
comparator.detects: Positive overcurrent only; does not establish reverse-current protection

logic.preferred_interface: SN74AUP1G17DBVR buffer plus SHDN pull-down; architecture only
logic.low_spec_condition: Buffer VOL max .1 V at 20 uA, or .33 V at 2.7 mA/VCC3 V; verify SHDN loading under actual conditions
logic.off_spec_condition: AUP Ioff max .6 uA at VCC0; LTC SHDN 15nA reference at SHDN10V/VIN60V; not brownout qualification
logic.slow_shutdown: LTC4367 SHDN uses slow gate discharge: 50..160 uA at stated 12V conditions; do not call it the fast UV/OV path
logic.uv_wired_or_rejected: INA300 ALERT leakage up to 1uA would shift the precision UV divider; no direct UV connection adopted

sources.use: pin map; threshold source and offset; NAF; latch; active DGS ordering code
buffer logic levels and off leakage
SHDN falling threshold; slow gate-discharge path
